out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located closest to the 2DR salad prep top unit is blocked by two carts and cleaning supplies in the sink, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HAND SINKS CAN NEVER BE BLOCKED AND MUST ALWAYS BE AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO BE ABLE TO WASH HANDS AND PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC MOVED THE CARTS AND CLEANING SUPPLIES OUT OF THE WAY OF THE HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Live cockroaches were found in the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE DISCOVERY OF THE COCKROACHES AND PIC TOLD EHS THAT THEY ARE AWARE OF THE ISSUE AND HAVE BEEN HAVING THEIR PEST CONTROL COMPANY COME AND SPRAY THE FACILITY AT NIGHT. THE MOST RECENT SPRAY TOOK PLACE THE NIGHT PRIOR TO THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip or waterproof dishwasher thermometer available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC WAS UNABLE TO FIND THE WATERPROOF DISHWASHER THERMOMETER THAT EHS HAD PIC ORDER DURING A PREVIOUS INSPECTION. PIC ORDERED ANOTHER WATERPROOF DISHWASHER THERMOMETER AND SHOWED THE INVOICE TO EHS.
